scope: Direct original ARM Print_print_float versus the registered production PicoNetworkPlatform.serial_write_float callback and actual pinned SDK float formatter. Real constructors, C double-to-float ABI conversion, float arithmetic, integer/string formatting, and virtual byte dispatch execute. Only HardwareSerial::write(uint8_t) is controlled to accept each byte. The original return count is checked; the new void callback has no return-value contract. Precision 2 covers parser diagnostics; other precisions verify argument forwarding. Non-NaN input bits are preserved exactly; the SDK double-to-float helper canonicalizes NaN signs/payloads. Special IEEE values preserve legacy byte output and do not claim physically meaningful readings. No UART peripheral or physical device is exercised.
